svg.title: KB-E2B6 v2.1 board: ports and controls (top view)
svg.desc: Top view of the 45 x 35 mm KB-E2B6 board, drawn to scale from the KiCad layout. Top edge, left to right: ENC 1, BTN 1, BTN 3, BTN 5. Bottom edge: ENC 2, BTN 2, BTN 4, BTN 6. Encoder ports: JST GH 6-pin, 1.25 mm: 1 A, 2 B, 3 SW, 4 GND, 5 LED-, 6 LED+. Button ports: JST GH 4-pin, 1.25 mm: 1 SW, 2 GND, 3 LED-, 4 LED+. Pin 1 of every port is drawn in the port colour (green for encoders, blue for buttons). USB-C (power and data) on the left edge, MCU STM32G474 in the centre, red status LED D16 and the on-board button (LED ON/OFF / BRIGHTNESS: short press LEDs on/off, long press brightness step) right of the MCU, SWD header J2 (2.54 mm: 1 3V3, 2 SWDIO, 3 SWCLK, 4 GND) near the right edge. Four M2 mounting holes.
